verdict.rationale: Resend's changelog refers to 'any official SDK' and lists SDKs as a supported surface alongside the API, CLI and MCP server. A hands-on community user praises the breadth and idiomatic quality of its SDKs across many languages, including Elixir. A published OpenAPI spec also supports building against the API. Missing for 10: first-party SDK documentation enumerating supported languages, installation/usage guides, and evidence of SDK feature parity with the API.
